summary: Built a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server 10.11 + galera-4) on node1/node2/node3, which started as plain Ubuntu 24.04 hosts with nothing preinstalled. Loaded application data, took the entire cluster down completely for a maintenance window, and brought it back up with all committed writes intact and all three members Synced/serving. Then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-client, galera-4, rsync on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and per-node wsrep_node_address/name
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster, then started mariadb normally on node2 and node3 to join via SST, reaching wsrep_cluster_size=3, all Synced
Generated root and app-user credentials on node1 with openssl rand; set root password; created appuser@% and appdb database
Created appdb.orders table, inserted seed rows, confirmed synchronous replication to node2 and node3
Stopped mariadb on node3, then node2, then node1 in that order to bring the full cluster down for maintenance; confirmed node1's grastate.dat had safe_to_bootstrap:1
Brought the cluster back up: galera_new_cluster on node1 (verified pre-maintenance row present), started mariadb on node2 and node3 to rejoin (cluster_size 3, all Synced)
Inserted a post-maintenance row (widget-5-post-maintenance) and verified it replicated to node1, proving full read/write operability of all three members after the maintenance window
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline plus healthy cluster/data state on all three nodes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded ack), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (8d1d94e2->533debc3) and mariadb rejoined with cluster_size=3, Synced, data intact
Restarted node3, confirmed boot_id changed (96c08b66->1fdc7b43) and full rejoin/data recovery

Restarted node1 (the original bootstrap node) last, confirmed boot_id changed (cfdbaef8->5dcf86b2) and it rejoined the existing Primary cluster as a regular member (not a re-bootstrap) with cluster_size=3, Synced, data intact
Final cross-check from node2 showing wsrep_cluster_size=3 and wsrep_incoming_addresses listing all three node IPs

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member Galera cluster established with application data, before maintenance
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped on node1, joined by node2 and node3 (cluster_size 3, all Synced); appdb.orders created on node1 and confirmed replicated with identical rows on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Committed write present immediately before the full cluster shutdown
evidence.summary: Inserted widget-4-pre-maintenance row on node2, synchronously certified across the cluster

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for the maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node3, then node2, then node1 in sequence (all report inactive); node1 grastate.dat confirms safe_to_bootstrap:1 for safe restart

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up with every committed write still present and all three members serving
evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped and shows all 4 pre-maintenance rows; node2 and node3 rejoined (cluster_size 3, Synced) each showing identical data; post-maintenance insert on node3 replicated to node1, proving full read/write recovery

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 boot-identity change and post-restart cluster/data recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8d1d94e2 captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 533debc3; mariadb active with cluster_size 3, Synced, and all 5 orders rows present

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 boot-identity change and post-restart cluster/data recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96c08b66 captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 1fdc7b43; mariadb active with cluster_size 3, Synced, and all 5 orders rows present

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 boot-identity change and post-restart cluster/data recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cfdbaef8 captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 5dcf86b2; mariadb active, rejoined as Primary member with cluster_size 3, Synced, and all 5 orders rows present

evidence.requirement: Independent cross-node confirmation of full 3-member cluster membership post-restart cycle
evidence.summary: From node2, wsrep_cluster_size=3 and wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all three node IPs (10.100.188.10/.11/.12), confirming full quorum after all restarts
